delivery_packages.title: Finish the small common contract
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Current profile and legacy fixtures are pinned.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Identity, revision, references, authoritative records and context boundaries pass shared positive and negative cases.

delivery_packages.title: Transfer complete packs and preserve attachments
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Captured folder format, digest rules and export limits are explicit.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Python, TypeScript, Hub and native hosts reopen transferred packs after originals are removed; attachment loss, unsafe paths and unsupported content are handled explicitly.

delivery_packages.title: Complete the Research lifecycle
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Original ORF fixtures and byte-preserved capture are available.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Continue, challenge, correct, refresh, redact, supersede and retract retain evidence, disagreement, permission and migration loss receipts.

delivery_packages.title: Prove independent Research exchange
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Two installed implementations support the same pinned Research case.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Independent workers exchange, revise and reopen a real investigation offline with source bytes, unknown fields and disagreement intact.

delivery_packages.title: Complete the six reference cases and context map
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Small-substrate scenarios expose unresolved semantics.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Person, Receipt, Contract, Project, Decision and System have fixtures and usable views; Research remains first and Workbook remains additional.

delivery_packages.title: Handle identity, composition and concurrent history
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Identity and authority boundaries are fixed for this increment.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Ambiguous matches are reversible; cyclic or unavailable references are bounded; stale edits and cross-device conflicts cannot silently lose data.

delivery_packages.title: Make profile authoring self-service
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Local publication and creation kits already work.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: An unfamiliar author scaffolds, validates, explains and publishes a separate data-only profile with actionable failures and no Foundation repository dependency.

delivery_packages.title: Authenticate publishing and remote resolution
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Publisher trust model and namespace proposal are reviewed for implementation.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Authorized publication, alias and ownership changes, revocation, approved refresh and private sources pass immutable-pin, rollback and offline tests.

delivery_packages.title: Finish one Hub discovery and authoring surface
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Canonical catalog and complete-pack contracts are available.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Human, JSON and MCP versions agree; desktop and phone flows create, find, edit and export useful local packs with explicit offline/error states.

delivery_packages.title: Operate moderation and honest adoption signals
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Publisher identity, privacy policy and reporting ownership are defined.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Moderation, reports, appeals and retention work; optional collection has authenticated consent, revocation and anti-abuse proof before activation.

delivery_packages.title: Release supported packages and clients
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Portable formats and package boundaries are pinned.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Clean installed Python, TypeScript and native artifacts pass exact-version compatibility; release artifacts, provenance and supported client instructions are durable.

delivery_packages.title: Accept Primboard as a trustworthy daily product
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Dirty Mac work is protected and a clean candidate is built.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Signed installed capture, convert, edit, search, recovery and complete export pass with the existing identity; private-store and Keychain proofs remain private.

delivery_packages.title: Recover and ship the generic Desktop host
delivery_packages.entry_gate: prim-sim source scope, provenance and reuse authority are resolved.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Clean native build, reconciled integration PRs and real signed open-edit-save/attachments/FDA/XPC acceptance pass on supported Macs.

delivery_packages.title: Prove accessibility and representative environments
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Working public and native candidate journeys are available.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Screen reader, keyboard, phone, localization, low-resource/offline and representative household/organization continuity tasks have retained results.

delivery_packages.title: Finish trustworthy local and remote ingestion
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Artifact lineage and scoped operation contracts exist.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Original bytes, source change/revocation/deletion, hostile recursion, cancellation, quotas and resumability pass local plus authorized remote connector tests.

delivery_packages.title: Enforce bounded agent operations
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Threat boundaries and knowledge-versus-authority semantics are explicit.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Actual runtime enforcement rejects unauthorized, expired, revoked and over-budget work; receipts, idempotency and emergency stop survive restart.

delivery_packages.title: Close security and private-data failure modes
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Source and data boundaries are inventoried without exporting private material.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Threat-led tests, key recovery, renderer/parser isolation, supply-chain controls and scoped independent security/incident review meet the declared release scope.

delivery_packages.title: Migrate incubators and prove compatibility
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Per-repository privacy, license and consumer classifications exist.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Every migration retains originals, versioned loss reports and second-reader proof; every remaining repository has an explicit private, tooling or historical disposition.

delivery_packages.title: Cut the public Hub over with verified ownership
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Old clients, provider ownership, costs and rollback artifacts are mapped.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: A reviewed production route change passes TLS, quotas, legacy clients, real external MCP host and observed rollback/return with accountable operators.

delivery_packages.title: Prove Browsers and consolidate its live services
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Login/gateway source is consolidated and the real-account test boundary is authorized.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Real Apple login, cookies, container routing, tenant isolation, expiry, monitoring and production rollback pass; old services retire only after compatibility gates.

delivery_packages.title: Make recovery, maintenance and free operation sustainable
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Current services and authority boundaries are inventoried.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Named operators, approved costs, supported versions, recovery goals and backup/key-loss/vendor-exit drills are exercised by a replacement maintainer.

delivery_packages.title: Establish actual stewardship and policy ownership
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Existing charter and reserved human decisions are retained.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Human-approved rights, licensing and standards policies have actual owners; outside contribution, transfer, succession and abandoned-maintainer cases are resolved.

delivery_packages.title: Deliver useful diagnostics, onboarding and support
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Representative cases and accessible product journeys are usable.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Coverage, Fidelity and Operability preserve unknowns; new user/publisher tasks need no founder help; maintained docs, examples, releases and support paths exist.

delivery_packages.title: Run independent acceptance and close the release
delivery_packages.entry_gate: Release candidates and scoped review materials are reproducible.
delivery_packages.exit_gate: Consented outside feedback changes tracked requirements; all critical gates pass and the weighted readiness assessment retains any explicitly accepted final-five-percent deferrals.
